    "Main_Findings": [
      "Curriculum harmonization is crucial for promoting cross-border higher education and regional integration in Africa.",
      "The EAC and SADC have made progress in developing regional frameworks for curriculum harmonization, but implementation remains a challenge.",
      "Differences in national education systems and regulatory frameworks hinder the harmonization process.",
      "Mutual recognition of qualifications is essential for facilitating student and professional mobility."
